- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Ottoman Empire's occupation from the 16th to the 19th centuries integrated its culture and religion into Wallachia, leading to unique cultural expressions like mosques and bazaars.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Strategic alliances with the Austro-Hungarian Empire made Wallachia an important trade center, contributing to its cosmopolitan identity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Proximity to Russia influenced Wallachia's political and cultural development, impacting literature, music, and visual arts.
